summary: Frontend-only verification of the 7-change UI/UX batch - ALL PASS. (1) LOGIN hero: gradient card renders cleanly, gift badge + 'Earn Real Cash' title + 'Complete simple tasks & games' subtitle are single-line (numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit) and centered inside heroContent, decorative coin icon (top-left) and rupee circle (bottom-right) sit in opposite corners and DO NOT overlap the centered text (title bbox verified at x=114, y=224, w=161, h=26 inside 390px viewport - clear of both 40x40 corner coins). (2) HOME header: compact; greeting 'Hii, RegressUser' is single-line; points pill (data-testid=home-points) shows ONLY '1,100' with the coin icon - 'pts' string NOT present (assertion passed). (3) BannerCarousel: ratio 0.375 of cardWidth confirmed in code (src/components/BannerCarousel.tsx:23); no banners in Firestore right now so the component short-circuits (banners.length===0 returns null) - no layout break. (4) DAILY CHECK-IN: button 'Claim +100 points' visible (data-testid=daily-checkin-button); after tapping, the whole Daily Check-in hero card DISAPPEARS (button count 0 after claim) and games grid moves up - behavior gated by `!claimedToday &&` in PlayEarn.tsx:66 and marginTop collapsed from 22->4. '+100 points claimed!' toast shown; points went 1000->1100. (5) GAME cards: all 5 cards (Higher Lower, Memory Match, Tic-Tac-Toe, Catch Rewards, Solve & Earn) render with single-line title + single-line subtitle (numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit + minimumFontScale=0.7). (6) WALLET: large purple 'Available balance' card is REMOVED (0 occurrences of 'Available balance' text on screen); balance now appears as a compact pill (data-testid=wallet-balance) in the top-right of the 'Wallet' header showing '₹1.10' (2-decimal ₹X.XX format via toFixed(2)); Withdraw card still fully functional (UPI/Bank Segmented, ₹20/₹30/₹50 chips, amount input, UPI input, Withdraw button all have testIDs and render); Transactions / Withdrawals history tabs render with existing entries; layout is vertically compact with no large empty gaps. (7) REGRESSION: offerwall task-detail Popup only shows 'Start task' (1 match, 0 'Open task link' matches); all three bottom tabs (Home, Wallet, Profile) navigate without crashes or red-screens. ADS code change (src/ads/index.ts rewrite with AppOpenAd re-preload on CLOSED + RewardedInterstitialAd class + preloading for the daily-checkin claim) is syntactically clean, loads under the available=!!(GMA && GMA.default) guard that no-ops on web - JS bundle loads with zero runtime errors on web preview (ads are native-only by design, not functionally tested per instructions). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in use. Console warnings seen are pre-existing React-Native-Web noise (shadow* deprecation, useNativeDriver fallback, pointerEvents deprecation, expo-notifications web stub) - not regressions from this batch.
critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx hero positioning is sound: coinA (top:18 left:18, 40x40) and coinB (bottom:18 right:18, 40x40) are absolutely positioned in opposite corners; heroContent is centered with maxWidth:100% - verified visually at 390x844 that neither coin overlaps the centered title/sub. On very small viewports the adjustsFontSizeToFit on both title/sub will shrink gracefully.
index.tsx points pill (lines 156-161): correctly renders only `{formatPoints(points)}` with coin icon - no 'pts' suffix. maxWidth:130 + adjustsFontSizeToFit protects long numbers like '10,000,000'.

wallet.tsx headerBalance pill (lines 104-112): uses `₹${balanceRupees.toFixed(2)}` for consistent 2-decimal display; testID='wallet-balance' present. No remaining references to the old big 'Available balance' purple card - cleanly removed.

PlayEarn.tsx:66 gating `{!claimedToday && (...)}` correctly hides the entire Daily Check-in hero after claim; marginTop on games grid conditionally switches from 22 (when hero shown) to 4 (when hidden) so the grid rises naturally - no empty gap.
BannerCarousel.tsx:23 ratio 0.375 of cardWidth = compact (~2.67:1), uploader guidance says 1200x450 which matches. Guard `if (!banners.length) return null;` prevents the empty-state layout break.

src/ads/index.ts rewrite looks correct: AppOpenAd preloads immediately in loadAppOpen(), re-preloads on CLOSED (every app open gets a fresh ad), and showAppOpen() respects both appOpenShowing and the appOpenShowOnLoad latch so cold-start + foreground-return both work. RewardedInterstitialAd correctly uses RewardedInterstitialAd.createForAdRequest (not RewardedAd) + RewardedAdEventType.LOADED - this fixes the silent-no-load bug on production native builds. Cannot verify on web (ads are native-only, no-op by design).
Only pre-existing RN-Web console warnings observed; no new runtime errors introduced by this batch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - 7/7 verifiable items pass; 2 native-only items (ads, FCM) excluded from functional testing per request but confirmed syntactically correct and no-op cleanly on web
